title: 台灣光子源 TPS~Taiwan Photon Source
focus: 3 GeV、518.4 m 雙彎消色散儲存環的輻射功率、低發射度、磁鐵對準、超導射頻、軌道穩定與頂注整合~Radiated power, low emittance, magnet alignment, superconducting RF, orbit stability and top-up integration in a 3 GeV, 518.4 m DBA storage ring
summary: 以 TPS 的 48 台 1.19 T 偶極與每圈 853 keV 的輻射損失為起點，理解 24 單元 DBA 晶格如何達到 1.6 nm·rad 的發射度，再把 240 台四極的磁中心對準、KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔、束流壽命預算、250 Hz 快速軌道回授、同隧道 496.8 m 增能環與真空內波盪器整合成可交接的 3 GeV 光源工程。~Starting from TPS's 48 dipoles at 1.19 T and its 853 keV energy loss per turn, see how a 24-cell DBA lattice reaches 1.6 nm·rad emittance, then integrate magnetic-centre alignment of 240 quadrupoles, KEKB-type 500 MHz superconducting cavities, the lifetime budget, 250 Hz fast orbit feedback, a 496.8 m booster in the same tunnel and in-vacuum undulators into a transferable 3 GeV light-source record.

units.anchor: 48 台 1.19 T 偶極磁鐵~48 dipoles at 1.19 T
units.title: 偶極輻射：臨界能量與每圈能量損失~Dipole radiation: critical energy and energy loss per turn
units.mechanism: TPS 儲存環把 3 GeV 電子以 48 台偶極磁鐵彎轉一圈，每台彎 7.5°、長約 1.1 m。電子在偏轉時沿切線方向發出同步輻射，光譜由臨界能量 E_c 描述，E_c 與 E³/ρ 成正比；每圈損失的能量 U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，必須由射頻腔每圈補回。500 mA 的儲存電流使偶極輻射功率達數百 kW，這些功率幾乎全部打在真空室下游的光子吸收器與光束線前端上，因此臨界能量與 U₀ 同時決定了光源的光譜、射頻功率需求與熱負載設計。~The TPS storage ring bends 3 GeV electrons around the circle with 48 dipoles, each deflecting 7.5° over about 1.1 m. While bending, electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially with a spectrum characterized by the critical energy E_c, proportional to E³/ρ; the energy lost per turn U₀ scales as E⁴/ρ and must be restored by the RF cavities every turn. At 500 mA stored current the dipole radiation reaches hundreds of kilowatts, almost all of it landing on photon absorbers downstream in the chambers and on beamline front ends, so the critical energy and U₀ together set the spectrum, the RF power demand and the heat-load design.
units.model: 先由磁剛度求彎轉半徑與偶極場，再算臨界能量與每圈輻射損失。Bρ = 3.3356×3 = 10.01 T·m；θ = 2π/48 = 7.5°、L = 1.1 m → ρ = 8.40 m，B = 10.01/8.40 ≈ 1.19 T。E_c = 2.218E³/ρ = 2.218×27/8.40 ≈ 7.13 keV；U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/8.40 ≈ 853 keV。500 mA 時 P = 853 kV×0.5 A ≈ 427 kW，水平每 mrad 約 427 kW/6283 mrad ≈ 68 W。~First derive bending radius and field from rigidity, then the critical energy and loss per turn. Bρ = 3.3356×3 = 10.01 T·m; with θ = 2π/48 = 7.5° and L = 1.1 m, ρ = 8.40 m and B = 10.01/8.40 ≈ 1.19 T. E_c = 2.218E³/ρ = 2.218×27/8.40 ≈ 7.13 keV; U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ = 88.46×81/8.40 ≈ 853 keV. At 500 mA the power is P = 853 kV×0.5 A ≈ 427 kW, about 427 kW/6283 mrad ≈ 68 W per horizontal milliradian.
units.verify: 以射頻系統的前向功率減反射功率、扣除腔壁損耗求得束流吸收功率，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；量測同步相位隨電流的變化反推每圈損失；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜形狀，與 7.13 keV 臨界能量的通用函數比較；以吸收器冷卻水的進出水溫差與流量核對實際熱負載。~Derive beam-absorbed power from RF forward minus reflected power less cavity wall loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); infer the loss per turn from the synchronous-phase shift with current; scan the bending-magnet beamline spectrum with a monochromator and compare with the universal curve for a 7.13 keV critical energy; check the real heat load from absorber cooling-water temperature rise and flow.
units.failure: 光子吸收器位置偏移或冷卻水流量不足時，輻射扇打到未冷卻的真空室壁或法蘭，局部溫升造成光子激發脫附與壓力暴增，嚴重時法蘭密封失效漏氣；電流愈高問題愈明顯，常在提升電流試運轉時才暴露。~A misplaced photon absorber or insufficient cooling flow lets the radiation fan strike uncooled chamber walls or flanges, local heating drives photon-stimulated desorption and pressure bursts, and in severe cases a flange seal fails and leaks; the higher the current the worse it gets, so it often appears only during current ramp-up trials.
units.misconception: 臨界能量就是光源能提供的最高光子能量。~The critical energy is the highest photon energy the source can deliver.

units.anchor: 24 個雙彎消色散單元~24 double-bend achromat cells
units.title: DBA 晶格與 1.6 nm·rad 發射度~DBA lattice and the 1.6 nm·rad emittance
units.mechanism: 儲存環的水平發射度來自量子激發與輻射阻尼的平衡，與 γ²θ³ 成正比，因此增加偶極數、減小每台彎角是降低發射度的主要手段。TPS 採 24 單元雙彎消色散（DBA）晶格，共 48 台偶極，留出 6 段 12 m 與 18 段 7 m 的直線段給插件磁鐵與射頻腔。嚴格消色散時直線段色散為零，但發射度有理論下限；TPS 允許直線段帶少量色散，把發射度壓到低於嚴格 DBA 下限的 1.6 nm·rad，代價是光源點的有效束流尺寸要加上色散與能量分散的貢獻。垂直發射度 16 pm·rad，對應約 1% 的耦合。~Horizontal emittance comes from the balance of quantum excitation and radiation damping and scales as γ²θ³, so more dipoles with smaller bends are the main route to low emittance. TPS uses a 24-cell double-bend achromat (DBA) with 48 dipoles, leaving six 12 m and eighteen 7 m straights for insertion devices and RF cavities. A strict achromat keeps zero dispersion in the straights but has a theoretical emittance floor; TPS allows slight dispersion in the straights to reach 1.6 nm·rad, below that strict-DBA floor, at the cost of adding a dispersion-times-energy-spread term to the effective source size. The vertical emittance of 16 pm·rad corresponds to about 1% coupling.
units.model: 嚴格消色散的 DBA 發射度下限為 ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x)。γ = 5871、θ = 0.1309 rad、C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m、J_x = 1：ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad。TPS 實際 1.6 nm·rad 對應因子 F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054，介於 DBA 下限 0.0645 與 TME 0.0215 之間；ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%。~The strict-achromat DBA emittance floor is ε_min,DBA = C_qγ²θ³/(4√15·J_x). With γ = 5871, θ = 0.1309 rad, C_q = 3.832×10⁻¹³ m and J_x = 1, ε ≈ 3.832×10⁻¹³×3.45×10⁷×2.24×10⁻³/15.49 ≈ 1.91 nm·rad. The actual 1.6 nm·rad corresponds to F = ε/(C_qγ²θ³) ≈ 0.054, between the DBA floor of 0.0645 and the TME value of 0.0215; ε_y/ε_x = 16 pm/1.6 nm = 1%.
units.verify: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合（LOCO 類方法）求實際 β 函數與色散，再用 X 光針孔相機量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推發射度並與 1.6 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測直線段色散，確認其大小符合設計；以斜四極掃描量測耦合與垂直發射度。~Fit the orbit-response matrix (LOCO-type analysis) to obtain actual beta functions and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole camera and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 1.6 nm·rad; measure straight-section dispersion with RF-frequency steps to confirm its design value; scan skew quadrupoles to measure coupling and vertical emittance.
units.failure: 低發射度晶格需要很強的色品校正六極，動力孔徑隨之縮小；若六極設定或磁鐵誤差使動力孔徑再減，注入效率與 Touschek 壽命同時下降，頂注頻率被迫提高，輻射劑量與注入擾動跟著增加。~A low-emittance lattice needs strong chromatic sextupoles that shrink the dynamic aperture; if sextupole settings or magnet errors shrink it further, injection efficiency and Touschek lifetime fall together, top-up must run more often, and radiation dose and injection disturbances rise with it.
units.misconception: 發射度只取決於電子能量，所有 3 GeV 儲存環的發射度都一樣。~Emittance depends only on electron energy, so all 3 GeV rings have the same emittance.

units.anchor: 240 台四極與 168 台六極~240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles
units.title: 磁中心、梗架對準與閉合軌道放大~Magnetic centres, girder alignment and closed-orbit amplification
units.mechanism: 四極磁鐵若偏離理想軌道 Δ，等於對束流施加 K·L·Δ 的偶極踢擊，全環所有四極的隨機偏移經 β 函數與工作點放大成閉合軌道誤差。TPS 儲存環有 240 台四極與 168 台六極，以墊片調整支腳後機械中心偏差小於 0.01 mm，旋轉線圈量得的磁中心偏差在 0.02 mm 以內，再把磁鐵整組安裝在梗架上對準。2014 年 12 月 31 日在 3 GeV 未開任何修正磁鐵即觀測到首道同步光，顯示對準品質足以讓束流直接繞行。研究也指出被磁化的真空室會擾動磁場並引入多極誤差。~A quadrupole offset Δ from the ideal orbit acts as a dipole kick K·L·Δ, and random offsets of all quadrupoles are amplified through the beta functions and tune into closed-orbit error. The TPS ring has 240 quadrupoles and 168 sextupoles; after foot shimming the mechanical centres were within 0.01 mm and rotating-coil measurements placed magnetic centres within 0.02 mm before the magnets were aligned as groups on girders. First synchrotron light was observed at 3 GeV on 31 December 2014 with no correctors powered, showing alignment good enough for the beam to circulate directly. Studies also showed that a magnetized vacuum chamber can distort the field and add multipole errors.
units.model: 隨機四極偏移造成的閉合軌道 rms 為 σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ。假設 β = β_q = 10 m、KL = 0.6 m⁻¹、N = 240、ν ≈ 26.2：√β/(2√2×0.588) ≈ 1.90，√(240×10×0.36) ≈ 29.4，放大係數 ≈ 56；σ_Δ = 20 µm 時未修正軌道 rms 約 1.1 mm，仍在孔徑內但遠大於數 µm 的束流穩定要求，必須靠修正磁鐵與束流基準對準收斂。~Random quadrupole offsets give an rms closed orbit σ_orbit ≈ √β/(2√2|sin πν|)·√(N·β_q·(KL)²)·σ_Δ. Assuming β = β_q = 10 m, KL = 0.6 m⁻¹, N = 240 and ν ≈ 26.2, √β/(2√2×0.588) ≈ 1.90 and √(240×10×0.36) ≈ 29.4, an amplification factor of about 56; σ_Δ = 20 µm gives an uncorrected rms orbit of about 1.1 mm, within the aperture but far above the micrometre stability users need, so correctors and beam-based alignment must close the gap.
units.verify: 每台四極以旋轉線圈量測磁中心與多極諧波，記錄相對機械基準的偏差；上梗架後以雷射追蹤儀量測各磁鐵相對梗架基準；有束流時進行束流基準對準（改變單一四極強度並找出軌道不受影響的位置），得到四極與 BPM 的相對偏差並與量測結果比較。~Measure each quadrupole's magnetic centre and multipole harmonics with a rotating coil and record its offset from the mechanical fiducials; after girder assembly survey every magnet against the girder references with a laser tracker; with beam perform beam-based alignment (vary one quadrupole and find where the orbit is unaffected) to obtain quadrupole-to-BPM offsets and compare with the measurements.
units.failure: 不鏽鋼真空室焊道經加工被磁化，相對導磁率略大於 1，在六極孔徑內產生額外的多極場，動力孔徑縮小、注入效率下降；梗架因地面沉陷而緩慢傾斜時，修正磁鐵電流逐月漂移，最終耗盡修正行程。~Machining can magnetize stainless-steel chamber welds so their relative permeability slightly exceeds 1, adding multipole fields inside sextupole apertures that shrink the dynamic aperture and lower injection efficiency; girders tilting slowly with ground settlement make corrector currents drift month by month until correction range runs out.
units.misconception: 四極磁鐵只要梯度正確，位置偏一點也沒關係。~If a quadrupole's gradient is correct, a small position offset does not matter.

units.anchor: KEKB 型 500 MHz 超導腔模組~KEKB-type 500 MHz SRF modules
units.title: 超導射頻模組、耦合器與低溫負載~SRF modules, couplers and cryogenic load
units.mechanism: TPS 儲存環以 499.654 MHz、諧波數 864 的射頻補回每圈輻射損失。三菱重工交付的 KEKB 型模組為單 cell 純鈮超導腔，在 4.5 K 運轉，加速電壓 2.4 MV、Q 值 5×10⁸，搭配額定 300 kW 連續波的功率耦合器。單 cell 加大口徑束管讓高次模傳出腔外，由束管上的吸收體消耗，避免與 500 mA 的束流產生耦合束團不穩定。超導腔壁損極小，但這少量熱量必須在 4.5 K 移除，每瓦都換算成數百瓦的室溫製冷功率，所以腔電壓、Q 值與低溫系統要一起規劃。~The TPS ring restores its radiation loss with RF at 499.654 MHz and harmonic number 864. The KEKB-type modules delivered by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries are single-cell pure-niobium cavities operating at 4.5 K with 2.4 MV accelerating voltage and Q of 5×10⁸, fed by power couplers rated 300 kW continuous wave. The single cell with large beam pipes lets higher-order modes propagate out to absorbers on the pipes, avoiding coupled-bunch instabilities with the 500 mA beam. Wall loss in a superconducting cavity is tiny, but it must be removed at 4.5 K, where each watt costs hundreds of watts of room-temperature refrigeration, so cavity voltage, Q and cryogenics are planned together.
units.model: T₀ = 518.4/c = 1.729 µs，f_rev = 578.3 kHz，h = 499.654 MHz/578.3 kHz ≈ 864。壁損 P_c = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀)，假設 R/Q = 93 Ω：V = 1.2 MV 時 P_c = 1.44×10¹²/(93×5×10⁸) ≈ 31 W；2.4 MV 時約 124 W。束流功率：U₀ 853 keV 加插件約 300 keV（假設）= 1153 keV，500 mA 時 577 kW，假設 3 組模組分擔，每組約 192 kW，低於 300 kW 耦合器額定。~T₀ = 518.4/c = 1.729 µs, f_rev = 578.3 kHz and h = 499.654 MHz/578.3 kHz ≈ 864. Wall loss is P_c = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀); assuming R/Q = 93 Ω, V = 1.2 MV gives P_c = 1.44×10¹²/(93×5×10⁸) ≈ 31 W and 2.4 MV about 124 W. Beam power: U₀ of 853 keV plus about 300 keV from insertion devices (assumed) is 1153 keV, or 577 kW at 500 mA; shared by an assumed three modules, each carries about 192 kW, below the 300 kW coupler rating.
units.verify: 腔體出廠前做垂直測試量 Q₀ 對加速場曲線，模組組裝後在水平測試台確認電壓、Q 值與耦合器表現；耦合器以逐步升功率的方式做 RF 調理並記錄真空與電弧偵測；運轉中由液氦蒸發量反推 4.5 K 熱負載，與 V²/((R/Q)Q₀) 的預測比較。~Before delivery measure Q₀ versus accelerating field in a vertical test, and after module assembly confirm voltage, Q and coupler performance on a horizontal test stand; condition couplers by stepwise power increase while logging vacuum and arc detectors; in operation infer the 4.5 K heat load from helium boil-off and compare with the V²/((R/Q)Q₀) prediction.
units.failure: 腔面場致發射或多重撞擊放電使 Q₀ 下降、局部發熱導致失超，腔電壓瞬間消失，束流隨即流失；耦合器窗口電弧觸發連鎖跳脫，每次跳脫都中斷用戶實驗並需重新注入，頻繁跳脫直接拉低可用度。~Field emission or multipacting lowers Q₀ and local heating quenches the cavity, the voltage collapses and the beam is lost; a coupler-window arc triggers an interlock trip, each trip interrupts user experiments and requires refilling, and frequent trips directly lower availability.
units.misconception: 超導腔幾乎沒有損耗，因此不需要做低溫功率預算。~Superconducting cavities barely dissipate, so no cryogenic power budget is needed.

units.anchor: 射頻電壓與能量接受度~RF voltage and energy acceptance
units.title: 過電壓、能量接受度與束流壽命預算~Overvoltage, energy acceptance and the lifetime budget
units.mechanism: 低發射度光源的束流壽命主要受 Touschek 散射限制：同一束團內電子互相碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向動量偏差，超出能量接受度的電子便會流失。能量接受度取射頻接受度與晶格動量孔徑兩者中較小的一個；射頻接受度由過電壓比 q = eV/U₀ 與動量壓縮因子決定。Touschek 壽命近似與接受度的三次方成正比、與束團密度成反比，因此垂直發射度越小、束團電流越高，壽命越短。殘氣散射與量子壽命則構成其餘項目。~The lifetime of a low-emittance source is limited mainly by Touschek scattering: electrons colliding within a bunch convert transverse momentum into longitudinal deviation, and those beyond the energy acceptance are lost. The energy acceptance is the smaller of the RF acceptance and the lattice momentum aperture, and the RF acceptance depends on the overvoltage ratio q = eV/U₀ and the momentum compaction. Touschek lifetime scales roughly with the cube of the acceptance and inversely with bunch density, so smaller vertical emittance and higher bunch current both shorten it. Residual-gas scattering and quantum lifetime make up the remaining terms.
units.model: δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q)))。假設 V = 3.6 MV、U₀ = 1153 keV（含插件）、α = 2.4×10⁻⁴、h = 864、E = 3 GeV：q = 3.12，sin φs = 1/q，φs ≈ 18.7°，δ_rf ≈ 4.5%。若晶格動量孔徑僅 3%，有效接受度取 3%；再降到 2.5% 時 Touschek 壽命約剩 (2.5/3)³ ≈ 0.58 倍。~δ_rf = √((2U₀/(πα·h·E))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))). Assuming V = 3.6 MV, U₀ = 1153 keV including insertion devices, α = 2.4×10⁻⁴, h = 864 and E = 3 GeV: q = 3.12, sin φs = 1/q, φs ≈ 18.7° and δ_rf ≈ 4.5%. If the lattice momentum aperture is only 3%, the effective acceptance is 3%; dropping to 2.5% leaves the Touschek lifetime at about (2.5/3)³ ≈ 0.58 of its value.
units.verify: 以直流電流變壓器在不補注時段擬合電流衰減求壽命；逐步提高射頻電壓，壽命先增後飽和的轉折點即晶格動量孔徑開始主導之處；改變單束團電流與垂直發射度，分離 Touschek（與束團密度相關）與殘氣（與壓力相關）的貢獻。~Fit the current decay with a DC current transformer during a pause in top-up to obtain the lifetime; raise the RF voltage step by step, and the point where lifetime stops improving marks where the lattice momentum aperture takes over; vary single-bunch current and vertical emittance to separate the Touschek term (bunch density) from the gas term (pressure).
units.failure: 一組射頻模組跳脫使總電壓由 3.6 MV 掉到 2.4 MV，q 降到約 2.1，射頻接受度隨之縮小，壽命驟降甚至無法維持束流；若誤以為壽命短是真空問題而去做烘烤，真正的動量孔徑或電壓問題被延誤處理。~A tripped RF module dropping total voltage from 3.6 MV to 2.4 MV lowers q to about 2.1, the RF acceptance shrinks and lifetime collapses or the beam cannot be held; mistaking the short lifetime for a vacuum problem and baking chambers delays fixing the real momentum-aperture or voltage issue.
units.misconception: 只要提高射頻電壓，束流壽命就一定會延長。~Raising RF voltage always lengthens beam lifetime.

units.anchor: 快速軌道回授（FOFB）~Fast orbit feedback (FOFB)
units.title: 軌道穩定度預算與 250 Hz 回授~Orbit-stability budget and the 250 Hz feedback
units.mechanism: 光束線要求光源位置與角度的穩定度約為束流尺寸與發散角的 10%。TPS 的垂直發射度只有 16 pm·rad，直線段的垂直束流尺寸只有數 µm，因此軌道必須穩到次微米。擾動來源包括地面振動、冷卻水流動、磁鐵電源漣波、溫度漂移與插件間隙變化。快速軌道回授以全環 BPM 讀值每秒更新數千次，經響應矩陣反解後驅動修正磁鐵，水平約 250 Hz、垂直約 300 Hz 的頻寬內可壓低擾動，頻寬以上則無能為力，甚至可能放大。~Beamlines need source position and angle stable to about 10% of beam size and divergence. With a vertical emittance of only 16 pm·rad, the vertical beam size in a straight is a few micrometres, so the orbit must be stable to below a micrometre. Disturbances come from ground vibration, cooling-water flow, magnet power-supply ripple, temperature drift and insertion-device gap changes. Fast orbit feedback reads all BPMs thousands of times per second, inverts the response matrix and drives correctors, suppressing disturbances within a bandwidth of about 250 Hz horizontally and 300 Hz vertically; above that it cannot help and may even amplify.
units.model: 假設直線段 β_y = 2 m：σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm，10% 準則要求 0.57 µm。積分型回授在 f ≪ f_bw 時抑制比約 f/f_bw：10 Hz、3 µm 的擾動在 250 Hz 頻寬下剩 3×10/250 ≈ 0.12 µm，符合要求；同樣 3 µm 若出現在 400 Hz 則幾乎不受抑制，必須從源頭（如泵浦或電源）處理。~Assuming β_y = 2 m in a straight, σ_y = √(16×10⁻¹²×2) ≈ 5.7 µm and the 10% rule demands 0.57 µm. An integrating feedback suppresses by about f/f_bw for f ≪ f_bw: a 3 µm disturbance at 10 Hz becomes 3×10/250 ≈ 0.12 µm with 250 Hz bandwidth, meeting the requirement, while the same 3 µm at 400 Hz is barely suppressed and must be removed at its source, such as a pump or power supply.
units.verify: 以 BPM 量測軌道功率譜密度，比較回授開與關時 1 至 100 Hz 及 100 至 500 Hz 的積分 rms；同時在光束線用光子 BPM 量光點位置，確認電子軌道穩定確實轉換為光源穩定；以注入已知頻率的人為擾動量測閉迴路傳遞函數，定出實際頻寬與放大區。~Measure the orbit power spectral density from the BPMs and compare integrated rms over 1–100 Hz and 100–500 Hz with feedback on and off; measure the photon-beam position on beamline photon BPMs to confirm electron-orbit stability translates into source stability; inject a known-frequency disturbance to measure the closed-loop transfer function and locate the real bandwidth and amplification region.
units.failure: BPM 電子學隨溫度漂移時，回授會忠實地把束流穩定在錯誤的位置，軌道看似穩定，樣品上的光點卻緩慢移動；修正磁鐵電源達到飽和時回授失效，某些頻段的擾動突然出現在所有光束線。~When BPM electronics drift with temperature, the feedback faithfully holds the beam at the wrong place, so the orbit looks stable while the spot on the sample creeps; when corrector supplies saturate the feedback fails and disturbances in some bands suddenly appear on every beamline.
units.misconception: 回授頻寬越高越好，可以把所有雜訊壓掉。~Higher feedback bandwidth is always better and removes all noise.

units.anchor: 同隧道 496.8 m 增能環~496.8 m booster in the shared tunnel
units.title: 同隧道增能環與頂注運轉整合~Shared-tunnel booster and top-up integration
units.mechanism: TPS 的增能環周長 496.8 m，與儲存環同心並共用同一條隧道，是運轉中光源設施最大的增能環之一；大周長讓組合功能 FODO 晶格在 3 GeV 達到約 10 nm·rad 的發射度，提高注入效率，也省下另一座隧道的土建。直線加速器的電子在增能環內由 150 MeV 升到 3 GeV，再注入儲存環。頂注運轉每隔數分鐘補充少量電荷，使儲存電流維持近乎恆定，光束線光學元件的熱負載因此穩定。增能環於 2014 年 12 月 12 日開始束流試運轉，12 月 16 日達到 3 GeV。~The TPS booster, 496.8 m in circumference, is concentric with the storage ring in the same tunnel and among the largest boosters at an operating light source; its large circumference lets a combined-function FODO lattice reach about 10 nm·rad at 3 GeV, improving injection efficiency and saving a second tunnel. Electrons from the linac are ramped in the booster from 150 MeV to 3 GeV and injected into the storage ring. Top-up adds a small charge every few minutes so the stored current stays nearly constant and beamline optics see a steady heat load. Booster beam commissioning began on 12 December 2014 and reached 3 GeV on 16 December.
units.model: 增能環 Bρ 由 150 MeV 的 0.50 T·m 升到 3 GeV 的 10.0 T·m，動態範圍 20 倍。假設儲存環壽命 10 h、每 2 min 補注一次：ΔI/I = 120 s/36 000 s ≈ 0.33%，500 mA 時 ΔI ≈ 1.67 mA；所需電荷 ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ = 1.67×10⁻³×1.729×10⁻⁶ ≈ 2.9 nC，約 1.8×10¹⁰ 個電子。~The booster's Bρ rises from 0.50 T·m at 150 MeV to 10.0 T·m at 3 GeV, a 20-fold dynamic range. Assuming a 10 h storage-ring lifetime and a top-up every 2 min, ΔI/I = 120 s/36 000 s ≈ 0.33%, or ΔI ≈ 1.67 mA at 500 mA; the charge needed is ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ = 1.67×10⁻³×1.729×10⁻⁶ ≈ 2.9 nC, about 1.8×10¹⁰ electrons.
units.verify: 以積分電流變壓器量測直線加速器、增能環引出與儲存環捕獲的電荷，計算各段注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 量測每次補注時儲存束流的注入擾動振幅與衰減；在儲存環 BPM 頻譜中檢查增能環斜坡重複頻率的成分，確認同隧道的雜散磁場不影響儲存束流。~Measure charge at the linac, booster extraction and storage-ring capture with integrating current transformers to compute each injection efficiency; record the injection transient amplitude and decay of the stored beam at every top-up with turn-by-turn BPMs; look for the booster ramp repetition frequency in storage-ring BPM spectra to confirm that stray fields in the shared tunnel do not disturb the stored beam.
units.failure: 注入凸軌的踢擊磁鐵波形不匹配時凸軌無法閉合，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性強度尖峰，時間解析實驗的資料被污染；增能環注入效率下降則補注時間拉長，輻射劑量上升並可能觸發輻射安全連鎖。~Mismatched injection-kicker waveforms leave the bump open, so every top-up makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds, beamlines see periodic intensity spikes and time-resolved data are contaminated; a drop in booster injection efficiency lengthens each top-up, raises radiation dose and can trip the radiation-safety interlock.
units.misconception: 頂注只是操作上的方便，對光束線的熱穩定沒有影響。~Top-up is merely an operational convenience with no effect on beamline thermal stability.

units.anchor: IU22 真空內波盪器~IU22 in-vacuum undulators
units.title: 插件磁鐵、光束線交接與試運轉里程碑~Insertion devices, beamline handoff and commissioning milestones
units.mechanism: TPS 的硬 X 光主要來自直線段內的插件磁鐵，例如蛋白質結晶學光束線 TPS 05A 與 07A 使用長 3 m、週期 22 mm 的真空內波盪器 IU22，涵蓋 5.7 至 20 keV。真空內設計讓磁鐵陣列直接置於真空中，間隙可縮到數 mm，提高場強與 K 值；但小間隙也讓磁鐵暴露於束流損失與尾場加熱。改變間隙會擾動軌道與工作點，必須以前饋表補償。交接以里程碑與驗收紀錄為準：2014 年底首光、2015 年 12 月儲存電流超過 520 mA、2016 年起開放用戶，規劃容量約 40 條光束線。~TPS hard X-rays come mainly from insertion devices in the straights; the protein-crystallography beamlines TPS 05A and 07A, for example, use 3 m in-vacuum undulators IU22 with a 22 mm period, covering 5.7 to 20 keV. Placing the magnet arrays inside the vacuum lets the gap close to a few millimetres for higher field and K, but small gaps also expose the magnets to beam loss and wakefield heating. Gap changes perturb orbit and tune and must be compensated with feedforward tables. Handoff follows milestones and acceptance records: first light at the end of 2014, more than 520 mA stored in December 2015, user operation from 2016, and a planned capacity of about 40 beamlines.
units.model: N = 3000/22 ≈ 136 週期。假設間隙 7 mm，B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λu)(5.47 − 1.8g/λu)] ≈ 0.70 T，K = 0.934×0.70×2.2 ≈ 1.44，E₁ = 0.950×3²/(2.2×(1 + 1.44²/2)) ≈ 1.91 keV。間隙開大到 K = 1 時 E₁ ≈ 2.59 keV，第 5 諧波 ≈ 12.95 keV，可涵蓋 12.66 keV 的硒 K 吸收邊。~N = 3000/22 ≈ 136 periods. Assuming a 7 mm gap, B₀ ≈ 3.33·exp[−(g/λu)(5.47 − 1.8g/λu)] ≈ 0.70 T, K = 0.934×0.70×2.2 ≈ 1.44 and E₁ = 0.950×3²/(2.2×(1 + 1.44²/2)) ≈ 1.91 keV. Opening the gap to K = 1 gives E₁ ≈ 2.59 keV and a fifth harmonic near 12.95 keV, covering the 12.66 keV selenium K edge.
units.verify: 以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測各諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較；移動間隙時記錄全環軌道與工作點的變化，確認前饋修正後殘差在數 µm 以內；以熱電偶與磁場量測追蹤小間隙長期運轉下的磁鐵溫度與退磁情形，結果列入光束線交接紀錄。~Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula; record ring-wide orbit and tune changes while moving the gap to confirm residuals of a few micrometres after feedforward; track magnet temperature and demagnetization under long-term small-gap operation with thermocouples and field measurements, and enter the results in the beamline handoff record.
units.failure: 小間隙運轉時若注入或束流損失打到磁鐵陣列，永久磁鐵受輻射局部退磁，K 值下降、諧波峰值能量偏移且強度降低，使用者在原本的能量找不到預期通量；500 mA 下尾場加熱使內襯變形，間隙無法再縮小。~If injection or beam losses hit the arrays during small-gap operation, radiation locally demagnetizes the permanent magnets, K drops, harmonic peaks shift and weaken, and users no longer find the expected flux at their energy; at 500 mA wakefield heating can deform the liner so the gap can no longer be closed.
units.misconception: 波盪器只能在基頻工作，高能 X 光必須靠更高的電子能量。~An undulator works only at its fundamental, so hard X-rays require higher electron energy.

example: 頂注與光學熱穩定練習：假設光束線第一面反射鏡在 500 mA 時吸收 200 W，熱致斜率靈敏度 0.05 µrad/W，鏡面到樣品 30 m，聚焦光點 5 µm。衰減模式下壽命 τ = 10 h，4 h 後電流 I = 500×e^(−0.4) ≈ 335 mA，吸收功率變化 200×0.33 ≈ 66 W，鏡面斜率變化 66×0.05 ≈ 3.3 µrad，反射光偏角加倍為 6.6 µrad，在 30 m 外光點移動 6.6×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 198 µm，是光點尺寸的 40 倍。頂注每 2 min 補注一次時電流起伏 ΔI/I ≈ 0.33%，功率變化 0.67 W，斜率 0.033 µrad，光點移動約 2 µm，小於光點的一半。補注所需電荷 ΔQ = 1.67 mA×1.729 µs ≈ 2.9 nC。數值為教學假設，不代表 TPS 實際光束線規格。~Top-up and optics thermal-stability exercise: assume the first beamline mirror absorbs 200 W at 500 mA, has a thermal slope sensitivity of 0.05 µrad/W, sits 30 m from the sample and focuses to a 5 µm spot. In decay mode with τ = 10 h, after 4 h the current is I = 500×e^(−0.4) ≈ 335 mA, the absorbed power changes by 200×0.33 ≈ 66 W, the mirror slope by 66×0.05 ≈ 3.3 µrad and the reflected beam by twice that, 6.6 µrad, moving the spot 6.6×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 198 µm at 30 m, forty times the spot size. With top-up every 2 min the current ripple is ΔI/I ≈ 0.33%, the power change 0.67 W, the slope change 0.033 µrad and the spot motion about 2 µm, less than half the spot. Each top-up needs ΔQ = 1.67 mA×1.729 µs ≈ 2.9 nC. Values are teaching assumptions, not TPS beamline specifications.
history: TPS 由國家同步輻射研究中心在新竹科學園區、緊鄰 TLS 興建，2010 年動工，施工期間還需監測地層變形以保護 TLS 運轉。儲存環採 24 單元 DBA 晶格、周長 518.4 m，增能環與儲存環同隧道同心配置；磁鐵製作與量測於 2013 年 10 月完成。2014 年 12 月 16 日增能環達 3 GeV，12 月 31 日在未開修正磁鐵下於 3 GeV 觀測到首道同步光，2015 年 12 月儲存電流超過 520 mA，2016 年起開放用戶。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~TPS was built by the National Synchrotron Radiation Research Center in Hsinchu Science Park next to TLS, with construction starting in 2010 and ground deformation monitored to protect TLS operation. The storage ring uses a 24-cell DBA lattice of 518.4 m circumference with the booster concentric in the same tunnel; magnet fabrication and measurement were completed in October 2013. The booster reached 3 GeV on 16 December 2014, first synchrotron light was seen at 3 GeV on 31 December without correctors, more than 520 mA was stored in December 2015, and user operation began in 2016. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
